title: SalesOrderPackList
description: PackList from provided Sales Order Id

PackingListInvoice.description: Invoices from the sales order id provided

SalesOrderIdEntered.description: The SalesOrderID that you entered in the reques

InvoiceIdEntered.description: The InvoiceID that you entered in the request

IncludePdfEntered.description: The value that you entered in the request. "True" is to return the encoded pdf string. "False" is to not.

PdfFound.description: Pdf for this invoice has been found

EncodedString.description: Enter this string in a string decoder to generate a pdf.

InvoiceId.description: Invoice ID of order. There is one per shipment.

SalesOrderId.description: Sales order ID. There is one per order.

PurchaseOrderNumber.description: Purchase Order Number supplied by the customer when the order was placed.

OrderedQuantity.description: Number of items ordered of products included in the packing list for given line item

QuantityShipped.description: The quantity of items in the shipment

QuantityBackOrder.description: The quantity of items on backorder

LineItem.description: DigiKey’s Line Item number for that Sales Order

ProductNumber.description: DigiKey product number for given line item

Description.description: Product Description for given line item

ECCN.description: Export control class number for given line item. See documentation from the U.S. Department of Commerce.

CustomerPartNumber.description: Customer Part Number for given line item

HTSUS.description: Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States for given line item. See documentation from the U.S. International Trade Commission.

ManufacturerProductNumber.description: Manufacturer part number for given line item

Manufacturer.description: Manufacturer Name for given line item

CountryOfOrigin.description: Country of origin for given line item

LotQuantity.description: Quantity of products in the lot for given line item

DateCode.description: Date Code for given line item. Format is MMM-YYYY

LotCode.description: Lot Code for given line item
